SELECT /*+INDEX(A KEP_STOCK_MNG_IDX_01)*/ SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 5, 2) AS YYYYMM , SUM(A.BASIC_QTY) AS BASIC_QTY , SUM(A.BASIC_AMT) AS BASIC_AMT , SUM(A.GR_QTY) AS GR_QTY , SUM(A.GR_AMT) AS GR_AMT , SUM(A.CHUL_QTY) AS CHUL_QTY , SUM(A.CHUL_AMT) AS CHUL_AMT , SUM(A.JO_QTY) AS JO_QTY , SUM(A.JO_AMT) AS JO_AMT , SUM(A.LAST_QTY) AS LAST_QTY , SUM(A.LAST_AMT) AS LAST_AMT , SUM(A.BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_QTY) AS BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_AMT) AS BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.AFTER_GR_CLOSE_QTY) AS AFTER_GR_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.AFTER_GR_CLOSE_AMT) AS AFTER_GR_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.BEFORE_CHU_CLOSE_QTY) AS BEFORE_CHU_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.BEFORE_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT) AS BEFORE_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_QTY) AS AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT) AS AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.NOT_DELY_QTY) AS NOT_DELY_QTY , 0 AS NOT_DELY_AMT , SUM(STOCK_QTY) AS STOCK_QTY , SUM(STOCK_AMT) AS STOCK_AMT FROM KEP_STOCK_MNG A /* 구매대행재고수불 */ WHERE A.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} GROUP BY A.YYYYMM ORDER BY A.YYYYMM
